notes.title: Busway Islands - Update 1.0.2f2
notes.content:
Dear Busway Islands Players,

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2301210/Busway_Islands__Puzzle/

We are pleased to announce a recent update that addresses and resolves issues related to achievements in the game. Players should now experience a more accurate reflection of their in-game accomplishments.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42866123/8272b8919c5accdd63c28c4912875e4744909853.png[/img]

[i]Atenciosamente,
Rising Moon Games team.[/i]

notes.title: Console release today!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that the game Railway Islands has been released on all video game consoles. You can get it to play in your living room with Xbox and Playstation, or on the go with the Nintendo Switch!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42866123/5186a9cf9a02b6e6346e62e1c45b970304ffbc37.jpg[/img]

[h1]Purchase on your favorite console through the links below:[/h1]
[url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/railway-islands-puzzle-switch/][b]Nintendo Switch[/b][/url]
[url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10005585][b]Playstation[/b][/url]
[url=https://www.xbox.com/pt-br/games/store/railway-islands-puzzle/9ngsw16bcl4x][b]Xbox[/b][/url]
